"def test_pid_check_behavior_manual_file_creation():

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Invalid body format"):
        WebhookNotification.from_request(invalid_body_2, invalid_header_2, secret)
    
    # Test with invalid header (to cover line 236)
